headlines.title: 《扩大消费“十五五”规划》： 持续巩固资本市场稳中向好发展态势 多渠道增加城乡居民财产性收入
headlines.summary: 国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，多渠道促进居民增收。健全按要素分配政策制度，促进多劳者多得、技高者多得、创新者多得。完善劳动者工资决定、合理增长、支付保障机制，健全最低工资标准调整机制，稳步提高最低工资标准，加强企业工资分配宏观指导。持续改善小微企业和个体工商户经营环境。促进房地产市场持续健康发展，持续巩固资本市场稳中向好发展态势，多渠道增加城乡居民财产性收入。加强税收、社会保障、转移支付等再分配调节。

headlines.title_en: "Expanding Consumption 15th Five-Year Plan": Sustain consolidating the steady and positive development trend of capital markets, increasing urban and rural residents' property income through multiple channels.
headlines.summary_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' promoting multi-channel income growth for residents. It will improve factor-based distribution policies, ensuring more pay for more work, higher skills, and greater innovation. Mechanisms for wage determination, reasonable growth, and payment security will be refined, with adjustments to minimum wage standards and macro guidance on corporate wage distribution. The business environment for small and micro enterprises and self-employed individuals will be continuously improved. The healthy and stable development of the real estate market will be promoted, the stable and positive trend of the capital market will be consolidated, and urban and rural residents' property income will be increased through multiple channels. Redistributive adjustments via taxation, social security, and transfer payments will be strengthened.

headlines.summary_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption', aiming for the overall scale of the consumer market to continue expanding by 2030, a significant increase in the household consumption rate, rapid growth in consumption of goods and services across society, total retail sales of consumer goods reaching around 60 trillion yuan, and a further enhanced role of consumption in driving economic growth.

headlines.title_en: "Expanding Consumption 15th Five-Year Plan": Deeply promote "AI + consumption", increase effective supply of new-generation intelligent terminal products such as AI phones and computers, smart wearables, intelligent robots, and desktop 3D printing devices.
headlines.summary_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' promoting high-quality development of digital consumption, deeply advancing 'AI+Consumption,' and implementing actions to boost digital consumption. It will expand digital product consumption, increase effective supply of next-generation smart terminal products such as AI phones and computers, smart wearables, smart robots, and desktop 3D printing devices, accelerate R&D and interconnection of smart security and video monitoring systems, and pilot access and road operation of intelligent connected vehicles.

headlines.title: 《扩大消费“十五五”规划》：有序放宽服务业准入限制，优化新业态新领域市场准入环境
headlines.summary: 国务院原则同意《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，营造公平开放的市场环境。有序放宽服务业准入限制，优化新业态新领域市场准入环境。强化平台责任与用户权益保护，推动平台经济反垄断与公平竞争。推动电信、互联网、教育、文化、医疗等领域有序扩大开放，增加高品质商品和服务供给。优化完善跨境电商零售进口政策，扩大境外优质商品进口。高质量办好中国国际进口博览会、中国国际消费品博览会等，集聚全球优质消费资源。

headlines.title_en: "Expanding Consumption 15th Five-Year Plan": Orderly relax access restrictions in the service industry, optimize the market access environment for new business forms and new fields.
headlines.summary_en: The State Council agreed in principle to the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' creating a fair and open market environment. It will orderly relax access restrictions in the service industry and optimize market access for new business forms and fields. Platform responsibilities and user rights protection will be strengthened, promoting anti-monopoly and fair competition in the platform economy. The orderly expansion of opening up in telecommunications, internet, education, culture, and healthcare will be promoted, increasing the supply of high-quality goods and services. Policies on cross-border e-commerce retail imports will be optimized and improved, expanding imports of high-quality foreign goods. Events like the China International Import Expo and China International Consumer Products Expo will be held to high standards, gathering global quality consumption resources.

headlines.title_en: Aluminum Corporation of China: Expects H1 2026 net profit of 11.2-12.2 billion yuan, up 58%-73% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Aluminum Corporation of China announced that it expects net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company for the first half of 2026 to be between RMB 11.2 billion and RMB 12.2 billion, an increase of 58% to 73% year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders excluding non-recurring gains and losses is expected to be between RMB 11.0 billion and RMB 12.0 billion, also up 58% to 73% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: "Expanding Consumption 15th Five-Year Plan": Expand inbound consumption, focus on increasing the number of international direct flights to Europe, the US, and Belt and Road Initiative partner countries.
headlines.summary_en: The State Council agreed in principle to the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' requesting serious implementation. The plan points out expanding inbound consumption. The inbound consumption environment will be optimized, building the 'Shop in China' brand. The scope of visa-free countries will be steadily expanded, and transit visa-free policies will be continuously optimized. International flight routes will be increased, focusing on direct flights to Europe, the US, and Belt and Road countries. The internationalization level of public services will be improved, the payment environment for inbound consumption will be optimized, and convenience for inbound travelers in fast customs clearance, hotel registration, transportation, telecom services, and scenic spot bookings will be promoted.

It expects net profit attributable to shareholders excluding non-recurring gains and losses of RMB 2.057 billion to RMB 2.263 billion for the first half of 2026, up 100% to 120% year-on-year. headlines.summary_zh: 中国人民银行在周三发布的声明中承诺维持“适度宽松”的货币政策，同时呼吁采取更具前瞻性、灵活性和针对性的方式，并首次将“结构性分化”列为国内关键挑战。这些言论出自中国人民银行货币政策委员会一次会议的通稿。

headlines.title: 国家发展改革委、商务部有关负责人就《扩大消费“十五五”规划》答记者问
headlines.summary: 国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，多渠道促进居民增收。健全按要素分配政策制度，促进多劳者多得、技高者多得、创新者多得。完善劳动者工资决定、合理增长、支付保障机制，健全最低工资标准调整机制，稳步提高最低工资标准，加强企业工资分配宏观指导。持续改善小微企业和个体工商户经营环境。促进房地产市场持续健康发展，持续巩固资本市场稳中向好发展态势，多渠道增加城乡居民财产性收入。加强税收、社会保障、转移支付等再分配调节。
